Reference path tracer — ground-truth comparator; no specific paper cited, but serves as the A/B target for radiance-cache quality assessments. The PT_HASH_GRID_CACHE_ENABLED-gated cache writes at secondary+ vertices port Capsaicin GI-1.0 hash_grid_cache.hlsl secondary-vertex pattern; the cache read at bounce>=1 ports Capsaicin's Site-3 (TraceReflectionsHandleHit, gi1.comp:2865-2900) read-only-replace-shading shape into our loop-per-bounce raygen. The secondary-bounce write — BRDF/pdf-modulated next-cell mean folded back into the previous vertex's slot — ports Capsaicin's UpdateMultibounceCells (gi1.comp:1962-1975) cell-to-cell feedback into the same loop-per-bounce shape (D1 collapses Capsaicin's separate UpdateCellValueIndirectBuffer onto the single direct buffer). Full audit at .alignments/TASK-77.1-rework-paper-port-audit.md.
entries.reference: Any path-tracer reference; this file is our own implementation. entries.paper: GI-1.0 §2.2 (World Cache) — open-addressing spatial hash with secondary-vertex outgoing-radiance storage. Direction-keyed (Capsaicin uses incoming-ray direction quantized to 5×5×5 buckets, NOT surface normal — D3 in the audit).
entries.notes: Per-axis pcgHash / xxHash32 chain by addition (Capsaicin sources from math/pack.hlsl, not fetched in audit; bodies inlined here are standard PCG and xxHash32). D1: kernel-per-bounce vs. loop-per-bounce — only the Site-3 read pattern fits, no UpdateMultibounceCells port. D2: capacity halved (NUM_BUCKETS_LOG2=13 vs. Capsaicin default 14). PackRadiance / UnpackRadiance use 4× f32tof16 / f16tof32 to mirror Capsaicin's packHalf4 / unpackHalf4 (math/pack.hlsl, not fetched). Full divergence list at .alignments/TASK-77.1-rework-paper-port-audit.md.

entries.paper: GI-1.0 §2.2 (World Cache) — running-mean update of the persistent ValueBuffer from the per-frame atomic-sum scratch (UpdateCellValueBuffer).
entries.notes: Ports the MIP-0 block of Capsaicin UpdateTiles (gi1.comp:2160-2225) only. The mip 1-3 box-filter cascade and the indirect-lobe (USE_MULTI_BOUNCE) duplicates are deliberately out of scope for this CL; PurgeTiles' 50-frame decay (gi1.comp:1715-1752) is also deferred. Wide non-indirect dispatch over every tile slot replaces Capsaicin's UpdateTileBuffer / IndirectDispatch dirty-tile tracking — until PurgeTiles + dirty-list bookkeeping land, the early-out on HashBuffer == 0 keeps unclaimed tiles cheap.

entries.paper: Troy Sobotka — AgX (display rendering transform). Sigmoid contrast curve in log-encoded display-referred space; replaces ACES Filmic tonemapping.
entries.reference: https://github.com/sobotka/AgX (canonical) + https://github.com/google/filament/blob/main/filament/src/ToneMapper.cpp (Filament's polynomial-fit port) + https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/dev/src/renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/tonemapping_pars_fragment.glsl.js (Three.js port the engine implementation follows)
entries.notes: Polynomial-fit AgX-Default — single-pass, no LUT. Matrices and EV bounds are named constants in the file; sigmoid is the AgXDefaultContrastApprox polynomial.
